arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Pospisil argued that trustees control the trust's citizenship.
He cited over two hundred years of Supreme Court precedent.
Justice Alito asked why the trust resembles a traditional trust more than an L.L.C.

paragraphs: This case asks who determines a trust's citizenship for federal court access.

sections.heading: How the case got here
paragraphs: The Supreme Court heard oral argument in this case on January 19, 2016.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: ConAgra wants the trust's citizenship to follow its beneficiaries.
Americold wants the trust's citizenship to follow its trustees.

sections.heading: What each side says
paragraphs: ConAgra argues the trust acts like a partnership of its beneficiaries.
Americold argues the trust acts like a corporation managed by trustees.

sections.heading: What the justices asked
